title: The embroidered paper portrait
alt: A folded-paper portrait is transformed into a finely stitched textile artwork.
description: A rendering-medium edit preserves the original portrait structure while introducing visible embroidery texture.

frames.label: Input
frames.alt: Layered terracotta, cream and blue paper forms a sculptural three-quarter portrait.
frames.prompt: A sophisticated editorial portrait assembled entirely from hand-cut colored paper. The three-quarter face of an adult woman is built from many precise layered planes of terracotta, cream, muted blue and deep plum. Carefully shaped eyes, a coherent nose and mouth, and a flowing mass of curled paper hair form a natural expressive face. The collar becomes an intricate arrangement of folded fans, narrow pleated strips and small paper leaves, all physically attached to the bust. Side lighting reveals fine cut edges and shadows between layers. Bold asymmetrical design, exquisite craft, warm neutral background, no lettering.

frames.label: Result
frames.alt: A folded-paper portrait is transformed into a finely stitched textile artwork.
frames.prompt: Transform the entire image into a richly embroidered textile artwork while preserving the exact subject, pose, face proportions, folded clothing design, composition and background arrangement. Represent the original pale colours with visible silk stitches, tiny thread loops and subtle gold couched lines following the existing folds. The subject and every major shape must remain recognizably the same; change rendering medium only. Refined tactile textile detail, no new objects or lettering.
